scenes.title: Cold open
scenes.text: Your phone just graded a whole class of paper quizzes. In seconds. Here's how.

scenes.title: Build the assignment
scenes.text: Build the assignment like any other, and set delivery to Paper.

scenes.title: Print the sheets
scenes.text: Print. Every sheet carries the student's name, a QR code, and four corner markers.

scenes.title: Students answer on paper
scenes.text: Students answer with a pencil. No devices in the exam room.

scenes.title: Scan with a phone
scenes.text: Snap the pile. The QR matches each student, the corners straighten the photo, and every bubble is read on the spot.

scenes.title: Review flagged marks
scenes.text: A smudged mark? It gets flagged. You see the crop, you tap the answer. Nothing is graded blind.

scenes.title: Results
scenes.text: Confirm, and the results and the full report land in the gradebook.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.text: Print. Scan. Done. That's your phone grading the whole class.
